buildCommand: node -e "const fs=require('fs'), cp=require('child_process'); if (fs.existsSync('src')) { cp.execSync('npm run build', {stdio:'inherit'}); } else if (fs.existsSync('frontend')) { if (!fs.existsSync('frontend/node_modules') && !fs.existsSync('node_modules')) { cp.execSync('npm install', {cwd:'frontend', stdio:'inherit'}); } cp.execSync('npm run build', {cwd:'frontend', stdio:'inherit'}); if (fs.existsSync('frontend/dist')) { fs.cpSync('frontend/dist', 'dist', {recursive: true}); } } else { cp.execSync('npm run build', {stdio:'inherit'}); }"
